QuestInfo.name: Where the Hero Fell
QuestInfo.0: #b#p502##k in #m10004000# wants to tell me something about the deep Ant Tunnel.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p502##k told me about the hero Tristan, who saved his life and fell deep in the Ant Tunnel while fighting the Balrog. Now #r#o45#s#k nest in that place. I need to defeat #r200 #o45#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated the #o45#s in the deep Ant Tunnel. #b#p502##k thanked me and asked me to remember Tristan, the way he does.

0.0: You brought Tristan's sword back to life. I haven't stopped thinking about him since.
0.1: He fell deep in the Ant Tunnel, fighting the Balrog... and he never came back up.
0.2: Now that place is full of #r#o45#s#k. They sleep where he fell. I won't let them have it. Will you defeat #r200 #o45#s#k for me?

yes.0: The #o45#s live in the deepest part of the Ant Tunnel, past #m10005075#. They are not mushrooms. Be ready.

no.0: I understand. It's not an easy thing to ask.

1.0: ...So it's done. Thank you. That place is quiet again, at least for now.
1.1: Take this. And remember Tristan, the way I do.

mob.0: The #o45#s are still there. Defeat #r200 #o45#s#k, then come back.
